title: Cemento PANAM breaks ground on Acajutla grinding plant expansion to 0.7Mt/yr
summary: Cemento PANAM breaks ground on Acajutla grinding plant expansion to 0.7Mt/yr
body_markdown:
**El Salvador:** Grupo Estrella subsidiary Cemento PANAM has begun building a second, 0.35Mt/yr production line at its Acajutla cement plant in Sonsonate. Estrategia y Negocios News has reported that the line will double the Acajutla plant’s capacity when it becomes operational in 2027. Cemento PANAM has also commissioned a new, 3MW solar power plant to 30% cover of the plant’s energy demand.


Sinoma CBMI Latin America originally completed construction of the Acajutla grinding plant, featuring a 155t/hr Gebr. Pfeiffer vertical roller mill, in April 2025.
